caseName: Children's Legal Foundation, Inc. v. Action for Children's Television
caseNameFull: Children's Legal Foundation, Inc. v. Action for Children's Television and Federal Communications Commission v. Action for Children's Television

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari denied.

Justice White and Justice O’Connor would grant certiorari. Justice Thomas took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.

Reported below: 290 U. S. App. D. C. 4, 932 F. 2d 1504.
